title: Synocene, Beyond the Anthropocene: De-Anthropocentralising Human-Nature-AI Interaction
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measures AI's attitudes towards nature, categorizing them as ecocentric, anthropocentric, and antipathetic.
base_benchmarks: Ecocentric, Anthropocentric and Antipathetic Attitude Scale test by Thompson and Barton [15]
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as its focus is on AI's attitudes towards nature and the environment.
